## JetBlue Launches New Nonstop Service from Fort Lauderdale to Indianapolis and Columbus Today


11/02/2026


Download (opens in new window)


*Daily flights bring JetBlue to Indianapolis for the first time and mark its return to Columbus, adding to a Fort Lauderdale network that will serve 61 nonstop destinations this winter*


*To celebrate the launch, limited one-way fares are available starting at $59 in Main and $138 in EvenMore only at[jetblue.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fjetblue.com&esheet=54633243&newsitemid=20261102220716&lan=en-US&anchor=jetblue.com&index=1&md5=e560f36b60b9f7b54c2ca68fa9c4c9b3)*


FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) will launch today daily nonstop flights between Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) and both Indianapolis International Airport (IND) and John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH), bringing new travel options to customers in the Midwest as the airline continues to expand its Fort Lauderdale network.


The inaugural flights bring JetBlue to Indianapolis for the first time and mark the airline’s return to Columbus. With the new service, travelers in Indiana and Ohio gain a new nonstop option to South Florida and service beyond to destinations across the Caribbean and Latin America, while Fort Lauderdale customers have more choices for travel to the Midwest.


“Today’s launches are another important step in building a Fort Lauderdale network that gives customers more places to go and more reasons to choose JetBlue,” said Daniel Shurz, senior vice president, revenue, network and enterprise planning, JetBlue. “We’re excited to introduce JetBlue to Indianapolis and welcome Columbus back to our network, while giving customers more opportunities to experience the service, comfort and value JetBlue is known for.”


**Giving More Choice from Fort Lauderdale**


Indianapolis and Columbus join a growing list of destinations JetBlue has added from Fort Lauderdale this year, further strengthening connections between South Florida and cities across the United States, Latin America and the Caribbean. Building on a year of expanded service and increased frequencies, JetBlue expects to operate more than 150 daily departures to 61 nonstop destinations this winter, marking its largest-ever schedule at FLL and providing customers with more opportunities to connect throughout its broader network.


The continued investment in Fort Lauderdale supports JetBlue's JetForward strategy, particularly its focus on building the best East Coast leisure network. By growing in key markets and improving connectivity across its network, JetBlue is offering customers more convenient travel options while strengthening its competitive position in South Florida.

**The JetBlue Experience**


Flights between Fort Lauderdale and Indianapolis and Columbus will operate on JetBlue’s Airbus A320 aircraft, featuring the airline's award-winning Main experience, including free high-speed Fly-Fi®, seatback entertainment with live TV at every seat and complimentary snacks and drinks.1


EvenMore® customers enjoy added benefits including extra legroom, priority security where available, early boarding, dedicated overhead bin space and additional onboard perks.


To celebrate the new service, JetBlue is offering one-way fares between Fort Lauderdale and Indianapolis and Columbus starting at $59 in Main and $138 in EvenMore, available on[jetblue.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fjetblue.com&esheet=54633243&newsitemid=20261102220716&lan=en-US&anchor=jetblue.com&index=2&md5=8b12ac407d4dee89b213a0353fb8a0c5) .2


Flights between Fort Lauderdale and Indianapolis and Columbus are available for purchase on jetblue.com and the JetBlue app.

JetBlue is New York's Hometown Airline®, and a leading carrier in Boston, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood, Los Angeles, Orlando and San Juan. JetBlue carries customers to more than 100 destinations throughout the United States, Latin America, the Caribbean, Canada and Europe.
